# Reliv Kiosk

> Reliv Kiosk is a self-service health screening kiosk, also called a Health ATM, from Reliv Medicare Private Limited in Kolkata, India. It supports everyday health, fitness and wellness awareness in campuses, workplaces, gyms and community spaces.

Company: RELIV MEDICARE PRIVATE LIMITED
Official website: https://relivkiosk.vercel.app/
Email: relivcustomercare.in@gmail.com
Phone: +91 91636 06455
WhatsApp: https://wa.me/919163606455
Companion app: https://reliv7.vercel.app/

## Screening
Blood pressure, SpO₂ (oxygen saturation), Pulse, Temperature, Height, Weight. Calculated indicator: BMI, calculated from height and weight.
Available sensors, optional eyesight screening, body-composition estimates and report access depend on the installed configuration. Confirm the included features with Reliv before purchase or visiting a kiosk.
A typical screening session takes about 3 minutes; timing depends on the selected checks and setup.
Guidance: English, Hindi, Bengali.
Reliv provides screening information for awareness. It does not provide a medical diagnosis or replace professional medical advice.

## Pricing
Kiosk purchase: Request current pricing for your kiosk configuration and installation location.
Monthly plans: Request a monthly plan quote and confirm the term, maintenance and support included.
Individual checkups: Checkup and digital-report charges depend on the station and service selected. Check the displayed price before payment.
No numeric starting price is published here. Machine purchase costs and session charges are different.

## Kolkata stations
- IEM Gurukul Campus, Sector V
- St. James' School, Kolkata
- Eco Park, New Town
These are listed partner-venue stations. Confirm current availability, access and opening hours before travelling.
